text: dsh-sidebar-panel-fold 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的侧栏插件。它在侧栏面板列表顶部注册一个本地化的「扩展」标题行，点击后可折叠或展开其他面板入口，并用箭头显示当前状态。插件通过页面样式隐藏其余面板行，将折叠状态保存在浏览器 localStorage 中以便刷新后恢复。适合希望收起侧栏入口、减少列表占用的 DSH 网页用户。无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-sidebar-panel-fold adds a localized header to the DSH web sidebar. Click it to hide or show the other panel entries; a chevron indicates the state. The fold preference is saved in browser localStorage and restored after reload. It requires no API key or external service.
想把 DSH 网页侧栏里一长串面板入口收起来。
有没有办法点击侧栏标题就折叠其他功能入口？
Can I keep the sidebar folded after reloading the web app?
dsh-sidebar-panel-fold 的功能「折叠侧栏面板入口」：在侧栏列表顶部添加带箭头的本地化标题行。点击标题即可隐藏或显示其余面板入口，折叠状态写入浏览器 localStorage，并在页面重新加载后恢复。

dsh-sidebar-panel-fold README · dsh-sidebar-panel-fold：A tiny **DeepSeek Harness Web UI** plugin that adds a collapsible group header to the sidebar, so the global panel entries stop eating the whole column.

```
▾ Menu entries        ← this plugin
    Plugins
    Plugin Market
    Schedules

Collapse it and only one row is left:

```
▸ Menu entries
```

The fold state is remembered in `localStorage`, so it survives a reload.

dsh-sidebar-panel-fold README · Option A — straight from GitHub (needs `git` on the machine)：Open the Harness Web UI → **Plugins** panel → *install bundle* and use

```
github:2646601154/dsh-sidebar-panel-fold
```

or from an agent session through the plugin-manager tool:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "github:2646601154/dsh-sidebar-panel-fold" }
```

The bundle is enabled as soon as it installs. If the sidebar does not change immediately, reload the window (`Ctrl+R` / `Cmd+R`).

dsh-sidebar-panel-fold README · Option B — clone, then install the directory：```bash
git clone https://github.com/2646601154/dsh-sidebar-panel-fold.git
```

then point *install bundle* at the absolute path of the clone:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "D:\\code\\dsh-sidebar-panel-fold" }
```

This is also what you want if you plan to edit the plugin — a directory install is linked, so changes take effect without reinstalling.

text: dsh-sidebar-panel-fold README · How it works (and why it is done this way)：`sidebar.panellist` is a plain list slot: each entry may only declare `{ id, order, label }`, and the shipped sidebar renders every entry as a **flat row** inside `nav[class*="panelList"]`. dsh-sidebar-panel-fold README · Compatibility：The hide rule matches the shipped CSS-module class names by suffix (`panelList`, `panelRow`) because they carry a build hash. If a future Harness release renames them, folding silently stops working; the fix is the two suffixes at the top of [`client.js`](./client.js) (`PANEL_LIST_SELECTOR` and the `panelRow` match). Issues and PRs welcome.

Written against `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` as shipped in DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`.

dsh-sidebar-panel-fold README · 中文说明：在侧边栏面板列表最上方加一行「功能入口」标题行，点一下就把 插件 / 插件市场 / 自动化任务 / 上下文洞察 / SSH / MCP 连接器 整组收起，再点展开。折叠状态记在 `localStorage`，刷新后保持。

安装：在插件面板里用 `github:2646601154/dsh-sidebar-panel-fold` 直接装；或者把仓库克隆到本地后用 `install_bundle` 指向该目录（目录安装是软链，适合想改代码的人）。装完若侧栏没变化，按 `Ctrl+R` 刷新窗口。
